messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: oncall-sre - HIGH severity - multiple API reachability and TLS handshake errors detected across Cloudflare edge POPs. Auto-created incident thread (1863123456).

maria: seeing 5xx spike starting ~09:11 UTC. Frontend logs show TLS handshake failures from client side (ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR).

sre-lee: confirming, our ingress logs (nginx) show `handshake_error` and `peer_closed` from 3 different CF edges. Rate of failed handshakes ~ 18% for last 5m.

ops-ryan: pulling Cloudflare status now, https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/ — looks like a partial routing/TLS degradation in ap-south and eu-westish? not sure.

aj: quick check: curl to api.redwood-inference.com from us-east returns `curl: (35) error:14077410:SSL routines:SSL23_GET_SERVER_HELLO:sslv3 alert handshake failure`

maria: ditto from our infra: `openssl s_client -connect api.redwood-inference.com:443 -servername api.redwood-inference.com` -> TLS handshake stuck, then timeout.

devon: did we push any CF changes in the last hour? I see a config deploy at 08:59 (WAF rule tweak) but nothing major.

ops-ryan: @devon I rolled back the WAF change at 09:14 as a precaution. No change in error rate yet.

customer-success-alyssa: FYI CS reports a handful of paying customers reporting failures in EU. they're asking for ETA and if we can route them differently.

sre-lee: impact assessment quick: ~12% of requests failing globally but concentrated in eu-west and ap-south prefixes served by CF POPs. Non-Cloudflare paths (direct origin) are healthy.

maria: hypothesis: Cloudflare edge certificate or handshake negotiation issue between certain POPs and our origin or their edge->client TLS termination. Could be a Cloudflare-side rollback.

incident-bot: Note: Observability ingest is partially delayed (logs seen with 2-3 min lag). Datadog reported intermittent API slowness in same window. correlate with CF event.

aj: mitigation options: 1) Update CF load balancer to remove affected pools/pop nodes. 2) Force failover to alternate region via DNS LB. 3) Temporarily bypass CF for critical customers using direct origin host header mapping. Which should we do first?

ops-ryan: I'm on the CF LB editing now. reducing pool weight for eu-west pop group to 0 -> applying.

maria: I'm preparing an emergency route rule for top 10 paying customers to add header `X-Bypass-CDN: true` so our edge will answer direct (already have backdoor route in runtime). will coordinate with ops-ryan.

sre-lee: timeline so far: 09:11 detect -> 09:14 rollback WAF -> 09:16 ops decreased eu-west weight -> 09:18 partial reduction in failures (now 9%).

aj: logs after weight change show fewer handshakes from eu-west POPs but ap-south still noisy. ops-ryan, can you add ap-south next?

ops-ryan: ap-south weight -> 0 at 09:23. applying.

maria: can someone post a quick diff of the CF LB change for the record?

ops-ryan: cf-cli command I ran: 
```
cloudflare load-balancer update --id lb-01 --pool-weights '{"eu-west":0,"ap-south":0,"us-east":100}'
```

maria: thanks. posting to incident timeline.

devon: after failing over, are clients seeing cert mismatch or are they routed ok?

aj: traffic stabilized for most customers once we shifted weight. TLS handshakes succeeded from alternate POPs. overall failures down to 2-3%.

customer-success-alyssa: CS notified top 10 customers in EU about temporary routing changes and that we are actively mitigating. no major escalations so far.

sre-lee: remaining 2-3% are likely intermittent edge flaps and possibly client-side caches still hitting bad POPs. will clear with CF purge?

ops-ryan: issuing CF purge for `api.redwood-inference.com` to nudge edge state.

maria: also enabling our runtime fallback policy to route by region preference -> prefer direct origin for EU customers until CF declares resolved. patching rollout flag now.

incident-bot: Conference bridge opened: +1-800-555-0123 pin 8741. Handoff notes: oncall shift at 09:30 UTC — @aj will take over post-mitigation monitoring.

aj: taking over monitoring. I'm going to keep the LB changes for the next 30 minutes and watch latency/error graphs.

devon: assigning postmortem to @devon. owner will gather CF timeline, our CF config changes, and customer impact.

customer-success-alyssa: recording impacted customers list (from support): acme-corp, blender-io, medica-app. notifying legal for any SLA exposures.

sre-lee: quick checklist for post-incident: 1) CF incident link + timelines, 2) config diffs, 3) logs and client handshakes sample, 4) steps for permanent mitigation (LB health checks / automated pool failover thresholds), 5) consider lowering DNS TTL for LB in future to speed failover.

maria: noted. also recommend we add health-check probes that detect TLS handshake errors (not just HTTP 200) so CF LB can auto-drain bad POPs earlier.

aj: monitoring note: set alert to 5% TLS handshake failure across any POP -> page oncall. current rule was only 20% which is too high.

ops-ryan: rolling that alert to 5% in the monitoring config now.

incident-bot: Incident set to MONITORING. Severity reduced to MEDIUM as mitigation in place.

aj: I'll keep the thread open for another 30m and then hand off to devon for postmortem. Thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:

devon: will own the follow-up. please dump any logs or CF support ticket ids to this thread.

maria: CF ticket created: #CF-87921 (submitted 09:20 UTC). linking to support notes.

sre-lee: adding sample curl failures for postmortem: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.com/health
* Rebuilt URL to: https://api.redwood-inference.com/health
*   Trying 198.51.100.23...
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to api.redwood-inference.com (198.51.100.23) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake error: SSL: certificate verify failed
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) SSL: certificate verify failed
```

customer-success-alyssa: will follow up with customers with post-incident summary once devon posts the report.

aj: last check at 09:34 UTC - error rate back to baseline. closing incident into MONITOR and handing to postmortem owner.

incident-bot: Incident 1863123456 transitioned to RESOLVED->MONITOR by aj at 09:34 UTC. Postmortem owner: devon.

devon: noted. will produce a timeline and RCA. thanks team.
